items.action: None, unless a screen must keep the faint field outline: set `--border-field: var(--border-default)` and `--border-field-hover: var(--border-strong)` on `:root`. A field of your own drawn to match the library fields takes `--border-field` and `--border-field-hover` for its border.
items.appliesWhen: `ds-input`, `ds-textarea`, `ds-select`, `ds-multi-select`, `ds-autocomplete`, `ds-search`, `ds-chat-input`, the `ds-date-picker`, `ds-time-picker` and `ds-color-picker` triggers, `ds-number-stepper`, `ds-otp-input` and `ds-field-group`, in both themes. Defaults that moved: `--ds-field-border-color`, `--ds-field-border-color-hover`, `--ds-input-border`, `--ds-input-border-hover`, `--ds-search-border`, `--ds-select-border-color`, `--ds-select-border-color-hover`, `--ds-multi-select-border-color`, `--ds-multi-select-border-color-hover`, `--ds-autocomplete-border-color`, `--ds-autocomplete-border-color-hover`, `--ds-date-picker-trigger-border-color`, `--ds-time-picker-trigger-border`, `--ds-color-picker-trigger-border-color`, `--ds-number-stepper-border-color`, `--ds-otp-cell-border-color` and `--ds-field-group-border-color`, each from `--border-default` (hover: `--border-strong`) to `--border-field` (hover: `--border-field-hover`). A value set on any of them still wins. Focus, error, success and disabled borders read other tokens.
items.pitfall: A field of your own styled with `--border-default` to look like a library field now reads fainter than the library fields beside it.
items.verify: At rest a `ds-input` border computes to `--border-field` (`#6B7388` in both themes), and on hover to `--border-field-hover`, unless `--ds-field-border-color` or the component's own border token is set.

items.action: None, unless your app sets `--surface-tint` for a brand: set `--surface-overlay-tint` and `--surface-overlay-raised-tint` beside it, for each theme it covers.
items.appliesWhen: The dark theme (`data-theme="dark"`) only. Inside `ds-modal`, `ds-drawer` and the `ds-app-layout` rail below `lg`, `--surface-tint` and `--accent-surface-tint` read `--surface-overlay-tint`; inside `ds-popover`, a `ds-menu` in it and the dropdown panels of `ds-select`, `ds-multi-select` and `ds-autocomplete` they read `--surface-overlay-raised-tint`. `--ds-list-item-selected-bg-color`, `--ds-tree-row-selected-bg-color` and `--ds-empty-state-tile-bg-color` follow there, and a value set on them still wins. The same overlays read `--accent-strong` from `--accent-strong-overlay`, lighter on dark, so the selected `ds-list-item` and `ds-tree` labels keep 4.5:1. Light values are unchanged.
items.pitfall: A `--surface-tint` or `--accent-surface-tint` override on `:root` no longer reaches inside those overlays; override `--surface-overlay-tint` and `--surface-overlay-raised-tint` as well.
items.verify: In the dark theme a selected `ds-list-item` inside a `ds-popover` is lighter than the popover, and one inside a `ds-drawer` lighter than the drawer.

informational: `ds-chat-input` takes `stoppable` and emits `stopRequested`: while `busy`, its send button becomes an enabled Stop button named by the optional `DsIntl.chatInput.stop`, with the new icon `stop`. Nothing to change in your code.

informational.text: The `ds-chat-input` send button stays enabled while the text is blank; pressed then, it sends nothing and moves the focus to the text area. Nothing to change in your code.
informational.verify: Open an empty `ds-chat-input` and press the send button: it keeps its colour, `submitted` does not fire and the caret lands in the text area.

informational: `ds-alert` takes `fullWidth`, which stretches the alert across its container. Nothing to change in your code.
`ds-tree` takes `<ng-template dsTreeLabel let-node>` (`TreeLabelDirective`, `TreeLabelContext`) for the label of every row. Nothing to change in your code.
Six icons are added: `mouse-pointer`, `pencil-ruler`, `columns`, `history`, `flask` and `panel-right`. Nothing to change in your code.

informational.text: An empty `ds-chat-input`, or an empty `autosize` `ds-textarea`, is one line of text tall: its placeholder takes one line and ends in an ellipsis, and the height follows `minRows` and the text. Nothing to change in your code.
informational.verify: Give a narrow `ds-chat-input` a placeholder longer than the field and type one character: the field keeps its height.

informational.text: A `ds-chat-step` keeps its marker beside the heading's first line for every `status`, as a `waiting` step does: with content or a `time` under the heading, and with a heading on two lines. A step with content under its heading is about 4px taller. A `waiting` step with a trailing action no longer draws its marker above the heading. A step with a one-line heading and nothing under it renders as before. Nothing to change in your code.
informational.verify: Open a `ds-chat-step` with text or buttons under its heading, and one with a two-line heading: the marker sits level with the heading's first line.

informational.text: A `ds-timeline-item` with content or a `time` under its heading keeps its marker beside the heading's first line, and is about 8px taller. An item with nothing under its heading renders as before. Nothing to change in your code.
informational.verify: Open a `ds-timeline` whose items carry a `time`: each marker sits level with its heading, not beside the time under it.

informational: A `ds-button` clicked while `loading` keeps the focus: the click reaches the button, which still refuses it. Nothing to change in your code.

informational.text: Under `data-theme="dark"`, `--shadow-1` (and `--ds-elevation-raised`, `--shadow-card`) starts with a 1px light hairline at 8% alpha, so the selected `ds-segmented` segment, the active pill `ds-tabs` tab, the `ds-switch` and `ds-slider` thumbs and a `raised` `ds-card` show an edge. The light theme is unchanged. Nothing to change in your code.
informational.verify: In the dark theme, open a `ds-segmented` control: the selected segment shows a thin light outline against its track.

informational: A `ds-splitter` drag released over an iframe or an embedded webview ends there: the resize cursor and the blocked text selection no longer stay on the page. While a handle is dragged, every `iframe`, `webview`, `embed` and `object` on the page ignores the pointer. Nothing to change in your code; a `pointer-events: none` you set on an embedded document during a drag can be removed.

informational.text: A `ds-icon` whose host also carries the global `.icon` class now has a box as large as its glyph: 20px in `ds-banner` and in the file rows of `ds-dropzone`, where the box was 16px around a 20px glyph, so the text beside it sits 4px further from the icon, and 14px in `ds-chat-attachment`, where it was 16px. Nothing to change in your code.
informational.verify: Open a `ds-banner`, a `ds-dropzone` with a file and a `ds-chat-attachment`: each icon box is as large as its glyph, 20px, 20px and 14px.

informational.text: The `ds-alert` icon centres on the title, or on the first line of the message when there is no title, where it centred on the whole alert. Nothing to change in your code.
informational.verify: Open a `ds-alert` with a title and a message: the icon sits level with the title.

informational.text: When any node of a `ds-tree` has an `icon`, every row keeps a 16px slot for it, empty where the node has none, so the labels of rows with and without an icon line up. A tree where every node or no node has an icon renders as before. Nothing to change in your code.
informational.verify: Open a `ds-tree` where only some nodes have an icon: the labels of sibling rows start at the same x.

informational.text: A `ds-chat-step` that finishes at once shows as running for at least 600ms, and steps of one `ds-chat-steps` show their final status at least 300ms apart; `minRunningMs` and `revealStaggerMs` on `ds-chat-steps` set the two times, `0` turns each off. Under reduced motion the final status shows at once. Nothing to change in your code.
informational.verify: Set three steps of a `ds-chat-steps` from `pending` to `done` in one change: they turn done one after another, not together.
